items.exampleEn: The school's administrative office closes at five.
items.exampleZh: 學校的行政辦公室五點關門。

items.exampleEn: She was promoted to supervisor after only two years.
The hotel lobby was full of tourists waiting for their rooms.
items.exampleZh: 飯店大廳擠滿了等著入住的遊客。

items.exampleEn: The whole school meets for an assembly every Monday morning.
items.exampleZh: 全校每週一早上都會集合開朝會。

items.exampleEn: My phone gave me a reminder about my sister's birthday.
items.exampleZh: 我的手機提醒我姊妹的生日到了。

items.exampleEn: Prices depend on the availability of fresh fish.
items.exampleZh: 價格要看新鮮魚貨的供應情況而定。

items.exampleEn: Every big event needs a good organizer.
items.exampleZh: 每個大型活動都需要一位好的籌辦人。

items.exampleEn: Two teachers supervise the children during lunch.
items.exampleZh: 午餐時間有兩位老師看管孩子們。

items.exampleEn: The travel agency gave us a brochure full of beach photos.
items.exampleZh: 旅行社給了我們一本滿是海灘照片的小冊子。

items.sentenceEn: Please wait for your visitor in the lobby on the first floor.
items.sentenceZh: 請在一樓大廳等候您的訪客。

items.audioEn: The library sent me a reminder that my books are due on Friday.
items.audioZh: 圖書館寄了提醒給我，說我的書星期五到期。
items.questionZh: 圖書館提醒說話者什麼？
options: The books must go back by Friday
The library will close on Friday
New books will arrive on Friday
A talk is held at the library

items.sentenceEn: My supervisor asked me to finish the report before lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 我的主管要我在午餐前完成報告。

items.sentenceEn: The organizer of the sales conference booked a hotel for all the speakers.
items.sentenceZh: 業務研討會的籌辦人替所有講者訂了飯店。

items.stemEn: Could you tell me about the ____ of the meeting rooms next Tuesday? I need one for the afternoon.
items.stemZh: 可以告訴我下週二會議室的空檔情況嗎？我下午需要一間。

items.stemEn: Ms. Lee will ____ the new workers during their first month.
items.stemZh: 李小姐會在新進員工的第一個月督導他們。

items.passageEn: Next month, our company will move into a new office near the station. Ms. Lee, the administrative manager, is the main organizer of the move. She has asked each team supervisor to supervise the packing in their own department. The new building has a large lobby with a cafe, and workers will finish the assembly of the new desks before we arrive. Ms. Lee has made a brochure that explains where everything is, and she will send a reminder to all staff one week before the move. Because of the limited availability of the elevators, each team will move on a different day. The building once belonged to a prestigious bank, so it looks very grand.
items.passageZh: 下個月，我們公司要搬到車站附近的新辦公室。行政經理李小姐是這次搬遷的主要籌辦人。她請每個團隊的主管監督自己部門的打包工作。新大樓有一個附設咖啡店的大廳，工人會在我們搬進去之前把新桌子組裝好。李小姐做了一本小冊子，說明每樣東西在哪裡，她也會在搬家前一週寄提醒給全體員工。因為電梯能使用的時間有限，每個團隊會在不同天搬。這棟大樓以前屬於一家很有聲望的銀行，所以看起來非常氣派。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼每個團隊在不同天搬？
options: 新大樓的大廳還在裝修中
電梯能使用的時間有限

questions.questionZh: 李小姐做了什麼來說明新辦公室的配置？
options: 帶每個團隊去現場參觀

items.promptZh: 她負責公司裡的行政工作。
referenceEn: She is in charge of the administrative work in the company.
She handles the company's administrative tasks.
rubricZh: administrative 放在名詞前（例如 administrative work、administrative tasks 等）
「負責」可寫，例如 be in charge of、handle、be responsible for 等

items.promptZh: 這本小冊子列出了這座城市所有的博物館。
referenceEn: This brochure lists all the museums in the city.
All the museums in the city are listed in this brochure.
rubricZh: 「小冊子」可寫，例如 brochure 等
「列出」可寫，例如 lists、are listed in、gives a list of 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 lists、listed 等）
